pairedRule: No case may regress in correctness, required-finding recall, false closure, correction accuracy or control unnecessary probing. Average repeats inside each case before comparing cases.
ordering: Alternate baseline then tombo on odd repeats; tombo then baseline on even repeats.
judgeRule: One independent blinded assessor rates both arms on identical criteria, binds every judgement to the output digest, cites output excerpts and source IDs. Schema checks are not semantic assessment.
boundary: New public synthetic configuration inheritance, UTF-8 byte limits and directed graph coverage cases. Same acceptance thresholds, repeats, repair and call/output/time caps. Both methods use the same low participant effort; speed, cost and effectiveness unproven. Different cases and profile prevent attributing differences to effort alone. Host costs/tokens UNKNOWN; G4 cap unproven.
freezeStatus: FROZEN before participant results; data GLM r1 and method/profile GLM r2 passed
callDefinition: Actual generation requests plus scripted source checks, including rejected requests. Hidden upstream requests unknown.
